#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <algorithm>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string x;
    cin >> x;
    
    int max_len = 0;
    int count_words = 0;
    
    int i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        if (x[i] != '_' && x[i] != '(') {
            int count = 0;
            int j = i;
            while (true) {
                if (x[j] != '_' && x[j] != '(') {
                    count++;
                }
                if (x[j] == '_' || x[j] == '(' || j == n - 1) {
                    max_len = max(max_len, count);
                    i = j;
                    break;
                }
                j++;
            }
        }
        
        if (x[i] == '(') {
            int count = 0;
            int j = i;
            while (j < n) {
                if ((x[j] == '_' || x[j] == ')') && count > 0) {
                    count_words++;
                    count = 0;
                }
                if (x[j] == ')') {
                    i = j;
                    break;
                }
                if (x[j] != '_' && x[j] != '(') {
                    count++;
                }
                j++;
            }
        }
        i++;
    }
    
    cout << max_len << " " << count_words << endl;
    return 0;
}
